doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

title: The violinist Valto and the Onward band
summary: Russell asks about a violin player called Valto, who lived on this side of the river. Neither man knows more. Martin mentions Jimmy Polar and Manuel coming up with the Onward band.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: Well, there's another violin player I wanted to ask about, Valto, they call him. Valto, well, Valto, he died. I think Valto died. Was he from this side or the other side? He lived on this side, Valto.

I never knew him either. Yeah, he lived on this side. Do you know his, any other name that he had? Was that his first name or last name? No, it was Valto. Do you remember Moody, anything about his name? No.
Valto, that's all I know is Valto. You take, uh, the violin player back up in there, who that was? Uh, no. Jimmy Polar in there, man. Over the river there. But he was living over the river. Yeah.
The old man Ullett, he was living over here. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Yeah, yeah.
Yeah, yeah. So you let me... You take, uh... The manual, he come up with the Onward band. Yeah. The Onward. The Onward. Yeah. The Onward. Yeah. The Onward.
